subject.title: Draft: add commands list and inspect inventory

question: Should OpenClaw ship this operator-specific `commands list/inspect` inventory as a separate supported contract from Gateway `commands.list`?
rationale: The open RFC leaves the public name, stable JSON fields, plugin API exposure, metadata lifecycle, and long-term convergence unresolved, so code review cannot safely choose the permanent contract.

options.title: Approve after hardening
options.body: Define the operator inventory's stable fields and ownership, repair error handling and documentation, add compatibility coverage and live proof, and explain why Gateway remains distinct.

options.title: Keep it experimental
options.body: Allow the implementation to evolve behind an explicitly unstable or internal boundary without promising stable JSON or plugin metadata yet.

options.title: Converge first
options.body: Design a shared canonical inventory layer with Gateway command discovery before exposing another public contract.

recommendation.title: Approve after hardening
recommendation.body: Define the operator inventory's stable fields and ownership, repair error handling and documentation, add compatibility coverage and live proof, and explain why Gateway remains distinct.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the primary historical contributor across the affected area and was explicitly mentioned for this product-direction decision.
